author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: The Ministry of Home Affairs has called for detailed reports from Punjab's authorities concerning two violent occurrences linked to the fight against drugs. The first incident, the murder of anti-drug activist Parwinder Singh in Mansa, ignited widespread protests. Meanwhile, an assault on Bikramjit Singh in Gurdaspur resulted in his death.
title: MHA seeks reports from Punjab govt on killings, suicide linked to anti-drug efforts

author: AASHISH VASHISTHA
title: Anti-Indian stickers with ‘Remigration now' message sparks row in Australia

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: The Times of India Sports Awards (TOISA) will return for its ninth edition in Dehradun on December 6, 2026. The awards will recognise India’s sporting achievements across disciplines, with the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya and the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow among the major events shaping the year. The ceremony will bring together athletes and teams whose performances have represented India on national and international stages.
title: Dehradun to host the Times of India Sports Awards on December 6

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Dipke, earlier today, had defended the party's protests, asserting that peaceful demonstrations were a democratic right. He accused the government of restricting citizens' freedoms and disrupting business activities through shutdowns, Internet suspensions and movement restrictions. "I'm alone, what law did I break," Dipke asked before he was detained. The court had directed the CJP to refrain from causing any public disturbance for a period of one year.
title: 'I am alone, broke no law': Dipke argues with Delhi cops as they detain him - watch

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: In a recent case before the ITAT Mumbai, the Income Tax Department carried out searches at a woman's residence and bank lockers, and seized diamonds, gold and silver articles, along with jewellery, which it treated as unexplained assets. The seized items included gold jewellery of 427.71 grams, 258 grams of pure gold, diamond-studded jewellery containing 161.33 grams of gold, and articles made of a silver mixture weighing 11.200 kg.
title: How much gold and silver can you legally keep at home?

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Michigan court upholds solar deals covering 563 acres in $330m project

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Caitlin Clark’s road to WNBA stardom was paved by a family that supported her basketball dreams early on; and her father, Brent Clark, taught her the basics and her mother, Anne Clark, gave her emotional support, and her brothers, Blake and Colin, added a competitive element to her upbringing, helping to shape the determination and athletic drive behind her rise.
title: Caitlin Clark's family: How her parents and siblings shaped her WNBA journey

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Connor McDavid, the rising NHL superstar, has been helped shape by a family that has supported his development, discipline and life away from hockey. His parents, Brian and Kelly McDavid, encouraged his early dreams, while older brother Cameron provided a competitive edge. He continues his career as captain of the Edmonton Oilers, and his wife, Lauren Kyle, has become a big part of his life personally.
title: Connor McDavid's family: How his parents, brother and wife shaped his NHL career

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: India has expanded its crude oil supply sources from 27 to 41 countries to improve energy security. The government is also increasing its refining capacity and exploring new oil sources in response to geopolitical concerns. Minister Hardeep Singh Puri emphasized the impact of global shipping disruptions on domestic industries and households. He outlined plans to enhance domestic energy production through initiatives like the Samudra Manthan scheme.
title: India diversified crude oil sources from 27 to 41 amid global disruptions: Puri

author: VRITI JAIN
description: In a chilling case, a local Meerut court handed down the death penalty to a woman and her accomplice for the heinous murder of her husband. To cover their tracks, they deceitfully placed a snake next to the deceased to simulate a snakebite. The court's decision drew on the Manusmriti and categorized the crime as 'rarest of rare.' The victim's family, having sought justice tirelessly, welcomed the verdict.
title: 'Snakebite' murder: UP court cites Manusmriti while pronouncing death sentence

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal announced the engagements while responding to a question from news agency ANI about whether Jaishankar was expected to hold any meetings in Mumbai next week. He also explained that hosting foreign dignitaries outside the national capital was not unusual, pointing to previous engagements held in different Indian cities.
title: MEA confirms Jaishankar-Rubio talks in Mumbai after Rahul’s jibe over India visit

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
title: Ilhan Omar's husband breaks silence after FBI raid on home; denies concerns over immigration probe

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Anvay is captaining a 16-member Karnataka squad in the tournament, which began in Visakhapatnam earlier this month. His appointment as captain comes 10 months after he made his India U19 debut against Afghanistan in Sri Lanka in November last year.
title: Dravid slams 151 as Karnataka chase down 358; Sehwag scores 173 in losing cause

author: PALLAVI
description: AISA chief Neha Bora was detained by Delhi Police while heading to a protest, and was taken to an unknown location. CJP leader Abhijeet Dipke was also detained at his residence shortly before the protest. Police stated the situation remained peaceful despite the detentions and heightened security in the capital. Hundreds of protesters gathered at Connaught Place and Mandi House, waving national flags.
title: 'Once again, an abduction': Aides claim Neha Bora taken to unknown location by cops

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Donald Trump indicated that the US may target Iran's Pickaxe Mountain facility to deter nuclear weapon development. He stated that nuclear weapons would not be necessary for achieving US objectives in the situation. The remarks followed ongoing US-Israeli strikes against Iran since February, amid rising tensions. Iran's foreign ministry denied any nuclear activity at the site, labeling US threats as baseless.
title: 'We'll knock it out fast': Trump may target Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear facility

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: China has acknowledged India's concerns regarding trade barriers and the growing trade deficit during recent discussions. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted India's challenges in accessing the Chinese market for its products. The trade deficit with China widened significantly, reaching $105.93 billion in the first nine months of the year. India is striving to improve bilateral trade ties with China through negotiations and ongoing discussions.
title: India flags trade concerns, market access barriers; China reacts

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Michigan appeals court has confirmed the validity of a survivorship deed that granted ownership of a house to Jessica Rae Harless. The ruling asserts that Shirley Ann Page's 2012 deed established a joint tenancy with rights of survivorship. Despite Anita Lanctot's challenge regarding the absence of the term 'joint' in the deed, the court affirmed that Page's intent was unmistakably conveyed, ensuring Harless retains sole ownership of the property.
title: Michigan woman’s survivorship deed upheld over daughter’s challenge

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
title: Jeremy Renner bought LA mansion for $7m, transformed it and sold for $24m

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: With a remarkable contribution of $13 million, Oprah Winfrey has solidified her legacy at the National Museum of African American History and Culture. Her financial support was instrumental in the museum's fundraising efforts, culminating in the naming of the Oprah Winfrey Theater. This theater serves as a vital space for public events, fostering discussions surrounding African American history and cultural narratives.
title: Oprah Winfrey’s $12m gift still supports Smithsonian theatre 13 years later

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Shubman Gill is set to return to action for Punjab in the 2026-27 Ranji Trophy season. He will play in the second-round match against Chhattisgarh starting on October 18. Gill missed the opening match against Assam, which was led by Uday Saharan. Recently, Gill was honored as the ICC Men's Player of the Month for the fifth time.
title: Shubman Gill returns to Ranji Trophy, set to play Punjab's next match

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Russian army lieutenant Lev Stupnikov took a perilous stand against his own military by secretly supplying Ukrainian forces with critical intelligence. His actions led to the targeted elimination of more than 300 Russian soldiers and deliberate sabotage of weapons systems, culminating in his flight to the Russian Volunteer Corps as a direct challenge to Putin's leadership. Stupnikov’s bravery reshaped the landscape of the ongoing Ukraine conflict.
title: Russian officer helped Ukraine kill over 300 troops by leaking military secrets

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Russia and the United States are set to announce new initiatives beyond their recent diesel agreement. Discussions reportedly include collaborative data centre projects powered by Russian nuclear energy. Supplies of diesel have begun reaching international markets following the deal with the United States. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has criticized the arrangement, expressing concerns about its implications for energy revenue.
title: Putin, Trump to announce several joint projects as Russian diesel returns to market

author: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA
description: A neo-Nazi teen attempted a mass shooting at a Hindu temple in Illinois, but his rifle jammed. The attack highlights ongoing debates about gun violence and societal issues, including parenting and mental health. Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi expressed horror that the attack targeted Indian Americans during worship. Many lawmakers condemned the incident, emphasizing the need to address religious and racial hatred in society.
title: US temple plot, school shooting: Gun epidemic spares no one as debate goes off target

author: PRIYANKA MUKHERJEE
description: Opposition parties in India are gradually uniting to support protests against the Chief Election Commissioner. Following arrests of CJP leaders, Rahul Gandhi showed solidarity, signaling a possible shift in strategy. Previously, Congress and CJP had organized separate protests over electoral issues, but they now seem to be collaborating more closely.
title: SIR protests: Opposition has found common ground. But can it stay united?

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed concerns over the US diesel deal with Russia. He warned that this agreement could provide additional funds for Russia's ongoing war against Ukraine. Zelenskyy emphasized the need for Europe to increase support to Ukraine as missile attacks continue. The president requested significant financial assistance to maintain Ukraine's defense against Russian aggression.
title: Zelenskyy slams Trump's diesel deal, says will help fund Putin’s war in Ukraine

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Josh Allen reportedly copied Stefon Diggs. As Diggs looked for Cardi B on the stands in the 2025 NFL season, Allen looked for Hailee Steinfeld from the stadium.
title: Josh Allen searches for Hailee Steinfeld after Bills vs Rams game

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Jason and Travis Kelce have partnered with Stoney Clover Lane to launch a New Heights-inspired collection featuring clear stadium bags, a fanny pack, pouches and custom patches. The accessories celebrate the brothers' podcast and its 92 percenters fanbase while combining practical designs with playful details. Available through the Kelce Clubhouse, the collection coincides with the launch of its "Outta The House" hub and upcoming in-person fan events.
title: Kelce brothers’ Stoney Clover Lane deal: What’s changing for New Heights merch?

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: The Gauhati High Court has granted bail to Sandipon Garg, the suspended Assam Police DSP, linked to the controversial death of his cousin, Zubeen Garg. Arrested by the Special Investigation Team, Sandipon follows Amritprava Mahanta, the first accused, who also received bail. Additionally, the Supreme Court emphasized the need for an expedited trial for festival organizer Shyamkanu Mahanta amidst discussions on the nature of Zubeen's death—accidental or conspiratorial.
title: Zubeen Garg death case: Gauhati HC grants bail to suspended DSP Sandipon Garg

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Ricky Hatton’s reported £40 million net worth has come under scrutiny more than a year after his death. Parents Ray and Carol Hatton and son Campbell are seeking clarity over his estate, including £18.7 million in DHT Finance funds and 20 companies. With no will, questions remain over the administration of his wealth and his children’s inheritance.
title: Ricky Hatton's £40M estate under scrutiny after death

author: NIRMALYA DUTTA
description: Ramaswamy is running to become Ohio governor, a position he perhaps sees as a stepping stone to something bigger in the party. Yet Ramaswamy’s association with Trump is increasingly becoming a liability among neutral voters, while his faith and skin colour are proving a deterrent among parts of the MAGA base.
title: Oh(io) No: Vivek Ramaswamy's Catch-22 problem with MAGA

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: The BCCI selection committee has announced India's ODI and Test squads for the upcoming tour of New Zealand. India will play five T20Is, five ODIs and two Tests on the tour. Fast bowlers Akash Deep and Anshul Kamboj have returned to the Test squad. Shubman Gill will lead India in the first three ODIs, while Shreyas Iyer will captain the team in the last two matches.
title: No Jadeja, Iyer to lead in last two ODIs: Check full Test and ODI squads vs NZ

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Siblings are embroiled in a legal conflict over the fate of their family-owned 60-acre farm in Pennsylvania. A sister residing on the land sought to sell it despite having a long-term tenancy. In response, her siblings filed an urgent petition to block the sale, citing property rights. The Pennsylvania Superior Court supported the injunction, illustrating the complicated nature of co-ownership and informal familial arrangements in property disputes.
title: Pennsylvania woman’s $250,000 family farm sale remains blocked after sibling dispute

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Recalling his sacrifices for Nitish Kumar, Anant Snigh claimed: “Who has made as many sacrifices as I have? Nitish Kumar was nothing back then. He used to roam around here and there. At that time, while being with Nitish Kumar, I got nine people murdered,” Singh said. However, later the leader clarified that his remarks was misinterpreted and that he was referring to the killing of nine of his associates.
title: 'Got 9 people murdered': On cam, big claim by Nitish's MLA; then clarification

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Larry Fink highlighted the risks of a recession due to a halt in data center construction during a CNBC interview. He emphasized that investments in AI infrastructure are crucial for the economy's growth and job creation. Communities opposing data centers are raising concerns ahead of the midterm elections regarding energy costs and environmental impact. While the International Monetary Fund projects steady growth, Fink warns about supply constraints affecting economic resilience.
title: BlackRock CEO warns US could face recession if data center ban is imposed

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: The US war with Iran exposed Tehran’s ability to disrupt the global economy by blocking the Strait of Hormuz. Before the war, around 19 million barrels of crude oil were exported daily from the Middle East. However, September data from tanker-tracking firm Kpler showed oil flows recovering to an average of 16 million barrels per day, the highest since the conflict began.
title: Return of Gulf oil: Has Iran lost grip on Hormuz & what does it mean for India?

author: GOKUL ANKARI
title: Indian charged in US for illegally voting in 2024 polls; faces up to 10 yrs in jail

author: VRITI JAIN
description: A protest march called 'Lehra Do Tiranga' saw widespread detentions by Delhi Police in Connaught Place. The event protested against the detention of Cockroach Janta Party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. Authorities restricted gatherings at Central Park due to a lack of official permission for the march. Parallel protests occurred near Mandi House, where demands for the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar arose.
title: 6,000 cops, 2 notices, Dipke among 150 detained: How unrest unfolded in central Delhi

author: MAITREE BARAL
description: Traveling can be exhilarating, but holding your urine might come at a cost. Ignoring bathroom breaks not only leads to discomfort but can also create chronic urinary issues. To prevent struggles with bladder control, ensure you take regular restroom stops and maintain hydration. Keep an eye on caffeine as well, since it may escalate urgency. If symptoms linger, consult a doctor to safeguard your bladder health.
title: The next rest stop is 40 min away: Should you hold your pee or find a toilet now?

author: HADI KHAN
description: Four men were arrested for the stabbing death of 23-year-old Shahid Hussain in southeast Delhi's Kalindi Kunj. Hussain was reportedly involved in an old rivalry due to a jail altercation from 2025. The police discovered a blood-stained scooter abandoned at the scene of the crime on Wednesday evening. Investigations revealed that the accused played different roles in the planned attack on Hussain.
title: Overtaken, knocked off his scooter, stabbed repeatedly: South Delhi murder on camera

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: ‘No one called Gandhi African’: Sanjay Raut slams order against actor Imran Khan

author: TNN
description: Police have detained four of the six suspects accused of murdering Manoj Gautam in Sitapur district. The incident occurred while he was returning from the local market on Thursday evening. Following the complaint from his family, an FIR was filed against the suspects, and the investigation is ongoing. Superintendent of Police Ankur Agrawal visited the crime scene to oversee the investigation process.
title: ‘Surrounded, attacked with lathis’: UP man beaten to death in broad daylight

author: MAYUR SHETTY
description: The introduction of the Account Aggregator framework has remarkably transformed the lending landscape, especially for borrowers without prior credit history. With loans totaling over Rs 3.82 lakh crore accessed through millions of accounts, new-to-credit individuals experienced significant growth in loan disbursements. Lenders benefiting from this framework reported quicker portfolio expansion and reduced delinquency rates, thereby amplifying economic activities in regions with improved credit access.
title: Loan seekers sharing bank data 3x more likely to get business loans: Study

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: The US Army is currently examining innovative wearable tech that provides soldiers with real-time alerts about incoming hostile drones during engagements. This compact sensor leverages unique acoustic signatures for immediate warnings, prioritizing soldier safety without burdening them with extra gear. Insights from the ongoing conflict in Ukraine underscore the necessity of advanced drone detection systems, ultimately aiming to bolster the effectiveness and protection of troops on the front lines.
title: Spotting drones before it's too late: US Army eyes wearable detection tech

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Tesla's CEO Elon Musk revealed a new flying car prototype at a SpaceX test facility in Texas. This next-generation Roadster features technology integrating cold-gas thrusters from SpaceX for airborne maneuvers. Musk shared that the vehicle can reach unprecedented speeds and perform impressive aerial stunts. The production of this innovative vehicle is expected to begin in the year 2028.
title: As Elon Musk shows 'flying Tesla', Meta AI head asks: Who is driving the tesla

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: In a remarkable achievement, Peter Daniell of Colorado has clinched victory in the 2026 National Civics Bee by tackling the pressing issue of food insecurity with impressive civic insights. Competing against 20,000 students nationwide, Daniell's essay underscored the vital role of community engagement and public service in ensuring food access. For his dedication, he was awarded a $100,000 education prize and expressed heartfelt gratitude for the backing he received.
title: Meet Peter Daniell, ninth-grader who beat 20,000 students to win $100,000 prize

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Queensland proudly announces the acquisition of three significant cattle properties, expanding its protected area network by almost 396,000 hectares. These lands are essential for wildlife conservation, providing critical habitats for various threatened species. Funded by the federal government through a biodiversity initiative, this move contributes to Australia's ambitious target of safeguarding 30 percent of its land and oceans by 2030.
title: Queensland protects nearly 396,000 hectares across three huge cattle properties

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Tesla's 'flying car' Roadster stuns in demo: How high can it fly & what will it cost?

author: NASEER GANAI
description: Omar Abdullah has raised concerns regarding the misconduct of IAS officer Kumar Rajeev Ranjan towards junior JKAS officer Beenish Wani. A video surfaced showing Ranjan's abusive behavior during an online meeting, which has sparked widespread outrage. Abdullah has instructed the chief secretary to protect Wani from any potential retaliatory actions post-incident. Political parties are demanding action against Ranjan for his behavior during the meeting.
title: ‘Not in keeping with expected standards’: J&K CM takes note of IAS ‘abusing’ colleague

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: India has added veteran pacer Bhuvneshwar Kumar to their lineup for the upcoming T20I match. This decision follows an injury sustained by Arshdeep Singh during the fourth match of the series. The final T20I will be held at M Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru, with the series tied at 2-2. India's selection committee hopes to finalize Arshdeep's participation before the match based on his recovery.
title: Bhuvneshwar Kumar added to India squad after Arshdeep Singh suffers shoulder injury

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Allison Ellsworth began making homemade soda in her Texas kitchen to address her digestive concerns before selling it at farmers’ markets. After appearing on Shark Tank and building Poppi through social media, her business grew to over $500 million in annual revenue. In 2025, PepsiCo acquired the prebiotic soda brand for $1.95 billion.
title: Texas woman turned homemade soda into Poppi; PepsiCo later bought it for $1.95bn

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: 'Orchestrated at Elon Musk's behest': Brij Bhushan on CJP's Tiranga march

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: 'Jagga Jasoos': Congress mocks Rajnath Singh over opposition demanding regime change

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Yuzvendra Chahal shared a chilling memory from his IPL journey that involved an Australian cricketer back in 2013. During a Royal Challengers Bengaluru party, he found himself dangerously suspended over a hotel balcony by an inebriated player. Terrified and with onlookers present, he was soon rescued. This episode has since propelled Chahal to concentrate on his cricket aspirations while embodying the hope of an international comeback.
title: ‘I was terrified’: Chahal on being hung from balcony by ‘heavily drunk’ cricketer

author: RASHMI DROLIA
description: A garba event at Civil Lines hockey ground in Durg faced tensions when Bajrang Dal and VHP workers objected. The conflict arose after an NSUI office-bearer shared a promotional poster mentioning free entry. Members of right-wing organizations confronted the gathering, leading to a brief scuffle on stage. Congress leader Dheeraj Bakliwal was pushed during the altercation, which escalated quickly.
title: Right-wing groups disrupt garba event, Congress leader shoved on stage

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Tech Mahindra witnessed an impressive surge of over 8% in its shares following the announcement of remarkable quarterly earnings. The IT giant recorded a 32.74% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit, buoyed by robust volume growth and effective cost management. In celebration of its 40th anniversary, the company also proposed a bonus issue.
title: Tech Mahindra jumps 8%, IT firm adds Rs 11,000 crore to market cap after Q2 earnings

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' has completed two weeks in theatres and is now into its third Friday. Ajay Devgn's thriller collected Rs 4.25 crore net on Day 14, a Thursday, across 10,809 shows, which took the India net to Rs 333 crore and the India gross to Rs 399.05 crore. Overseas, Rs 1 crore on the same day lifted the overseas gross to Rs 116 crore and the worldwide gross to Rs 515.05 crore. The Rs. 400 crore India gross mark is about to fall, with Rs. 350 crore India net and Rs. 525 crore worldwide the next targets.
title: 'Drishyam 3' BO Day 15 [LIVE]: Eyes elusive Rs 350 crore India net mark

author: ARANI BASU
description: For over a year, attention has centered on the struggling No. 8 batting position, an area that has failed to deliver consistent results. Nitish Kumar Reddy and Naman Dhir have been experimented with, yet their talents remain largely untapped. The team grapples with achieving the right balance due to the lack of a competent all-rounder.
title: India’s No. 8 obsession: Why Kuldeep Yadav is caught in the crossfire

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A 10-year-old girl from New Jersey has been named among the Top 10 winners of Creative Communication’s national poetry contest. Luisa Gonzalez’s poem, All Stitched Together, was selected from thousands of entries. Inspired by the Colombian flag, the poem reflects her cultural identity and pride in her heritage. She had previously received honourable mentions in the competition.
title: New Jersey girl, 10, reaches national poetry contest top 10 from thousands of entries

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
title: Virginia acquires 2,211 acres to protect trout streams and create conservation area

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Aneeshwar Kunchala, a passionate young wildlife educator, is set to receive the prestigious Junior Jane Goodall Earth Medal in 2026. His journey into conservation began at just four years old when he learned about the devastating effects of plastic on whales. Celebrated for his remarkable contributions to wildlife advocacy through media, he has initiated citizen science projects and engaging educational presentations that inspire children to connect with nature.
title: Meet Aneeshwar Kunchala, 11, set to receive Jane Goodall Earth Medal

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Renewed talks between the U.S. and Myanmar's military-backed rulers signal strategic interests in rare-earth resources. These discussions focused on securing the release of an American businessman and addressing online scams. Engagement follows Myanmar's civil war, which has led to extensive displacement and control challenges. Myanmar's Kachin State is crucial for heavy rare-earth minerals but is fraught with conflict.
title: US holds secret Myanmar talks as rare earth minerals at stake

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Barbra Streisand's generous donation of $10 million to Cedars-Sinai has paved the way for the creation of the Women’s Heart Center. This groundbreaking facility aims to delve into the disparities in cardiovascular health among women, addressing unique diagnostic and treatment challenges. Annually, over 1,700 women benefit from specialized cardiac care, emphasizing tailored medical approaches for heart disease, ultimately showcasing the critical need for research in women's health.
title: Barbra Streisand’s $10m gift now helps provide heart care to 1,700 women a year

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Following India's defeat against West Indies, Mohammad Kaif expressed his apprehensions concerning the team's selection strategy. He emphasized that the bowling attack was inadequate throughout the series, leading to a failure in containing the West Indies' strong batting. Kaif also pointed out that Kuldeep Yadav's omission created an imbalance in the team, which is crucial as the series now stands at 2-2 with a decisive match upcoming.
title: ‘Batting till No.8 is not bravery’: Ex-India batter slams Iyer’s team selection

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: A federal judge has ordered the reopening of the diversity visa lottery for 2027, allowing 55,000 applicants. The ruling came after a lawsuit filed against Secretary of State Marco Rubio regarding the lottery's registration. Judge Jinsook Ohta mandated a 30-day registration period for submissions, which must meet eligibility requirements. Additionally, new policy changes require some applicants to return to their home countries for Green Card processing.
title: Court tells US to process Green Card applications for up to 55,000 people by these dates

author: AASTHA JHA
title: 'FriYAY plans? We got ideas for you!' CJP issues call for Tiranga march as CP park shut

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: 'Hope better sense prevails': SC flags livelihood concerns as Delhi braces for CJP stir

author: AASTHA JHA
title: 'People of Punjab want answers': Shah slams Mann govt over attacks on anti-drug activists

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: INS Samarthak has been commissioned as a multi-purpose vessel by the Indian Navy at the Karwar naval base. The ship, with various operational capabilities, is designed to support future Navy missions and technology trials. It can be utilized for tasks ranging from humanitarian assistance to maritime surveillance and environmental protection. Developed by Larsen and Toubro, this vessel significantly incorporates indigenous content in its construction.
title: A mothership for drones, a testbed for weapons: What INS Samarthak brings to Indian Navy

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: India and Russia are set to conduct Exercise INDRA from October 13 to 18, 2026. The Indian Navy's INS Sahyadri arrived at Vladivostok for the exercise, which includes naval and harbour-based engagements. This series of exercises aims to enhance mutual understanding and interoperability between the two navies. The INDRA exercise reflects the growing defense cooperation between India and Russia.
title: India and Russia begin naval wargame INDRA in Russian waters

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Recent findings show that Thwaites Glacier might be a far bigger player in sea-level rise than previously thought. As warm ocean waters intrude beneath its icy surface, the glacier is melting at an alarming rate. If this trend persists, we could see a catastrophic detachment from the Mouginot Ridge by the year 2100.
title: Britain-sized Doomsday Glacier is melting faster than feared

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In response to the escalating conflict, Air India has halted all flights to and from Saudi Arabia until October 20. This decision aligns with similar suspensions by other carriers such as Air France-KLM and Gulf Air. Affected passengers will receive refunds, as the airline prioritizes safety amidst growing operational costs, further amplified by the ongoing turbulence in the Middle East that disrupts travel and markets alike.
title: Air India cancels all flights to and from three Saudi cities till October 20

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: A retired scientist took legal action against State Bank of India for failing to inform him about his deposit's maturity. The consumer commission determined that SBI did not communicate properly regarding the deposit and extension options. As a result, the commission found SBI had retained his funds without justification after maturity. The commission ordered the bank to pay him the original deposit amount along with interest.
title: SBI ordered to pay retired scientist Rs 15L after failing to inform about FD maturity

author: AASTHA JHA
title: 'You might want to explain unless you want me to': Rahul's cryptic post over Rubio visit

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Twitter co-founder Jack Dorsey has made bold moves in the real estate market, acquiring two stunning properties in the upscale Sea Cliff neighborhood of San Francisco. His first investment of $9.99 million sparked an extensive redevelopment that aims to create a serene wellness retreat, prioritizing privacy and a connection to nature. Following this, he invested $21.9 million in a neighboring property, expanding his sanctuary amidst the ongoing renovation's intricate progress.
title: Jack Dorsey spent $31.9m buying two neighbouring San Francisco homes

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: At 82, Joni Mitchell, the iconic Canadian singer-songwriter, has officially become a United States citizen. She shared her joyous moment of naturalization via social media, reminiscing about her journey since moving to the US in 1965. This milestone not only recognizes her profound impact on American music but also grants her the privilege of voting in US elections, solidifying her bond with the country she has long called home.
title: Joni Mitchell becomes US citizen at 82, six decades after moving from Canada

author: HADI KHAN
description: Businessman Shiva Sharma died after falling from a building, with his partner Shraddha Dubey accused of involvement. Videos surfaced showing Dubey confronting Sharma over alleged theft before his death. Sharma's family claims Dubey pushed him, while she asserts he died by suicide. Police have extended their search for Dubey and her associates to Nepal after they went missing.
title: 3 videos, Nepal ‘location’ and a ‘mysterious sir’: Hunt on for influencer Shraddha Dubey

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Daymond John started FUBU with a small investment and his mother's support in the early 1990s. He sold handmade hats in Queens and quickly generated significant sales, showing demand for the brand. After facing multiple rejections from banks, his mother provided financial backing through a second mortgage. Collaborating with musicians like LL Cool J helped boost the brand's visibility and credibility.
title: FUBU founder Daymond John turned $40 fabric budget into brand with $6bn-plus sales

description: In a shocking turn of events, Rekha Arya, a cabinet minister in Uttarakhand, has lodged a police complaint against her husband, Girdhari Lal Sahu, alleging serious offenses such as physical assault, forgery, and plotting her murder. Arya disclosed recordings in which Sahu reportedly reveals intentions to cause her harm, amplifying her concerns.
title: 'I'll get her killed': Uttarakhand minister Rekha Arya's husband in explosive audio

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: The US government is launching a $335,000 initiative to investigate the low application rates of Afrikaner refugees. This includes focus groups and a comprehensive survey to collect relevant data. This move comes after President Donald Trump emphasized the need for Afrikaner resettlement amidst claims of persecution in South Africa. However, the South African government contests these genocide allegations, asserting a commitment to rectifying historical injustices.
title: US administration plans $335,000 ad campaign as Afrikaner refugee interest falls short

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Doña Ángela Garfias Vázquez has captivated audiences on her YouTube channel, which celebrates traditional cooking from rural Michoacán. Her approachable recipes, rooted in familiar ingredients and time-honored methods, focus on the joy of cooking itself rather than high production values. Since its inception in 2019, her channel has garnered widespread acclaim, illuminating the rich tapestry of authentic Mexican culinary heritage.
title: Mexican grandmother, 75, gets more cooking-channel views than Martha Stewart

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Jeff Bezos has made a substantial $2 billion investment in Blue Origin, aiming to bolster competition in the burgeoning space industry. With aspirations to ramp up revenue from $800 million projected in 2025 to over $30 billion by 2030, the company is prioritizing rocket launches and satellite communications. Chief Executive Dave Limp has underscored the importance of advanced technology and streamlined operations.
title: Jeff Bezos has invested $30 billion in SpaceX rival Blue Origin, documents reveal

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a remarkable display of bravery, a five-year-old boy named Hudson Tenn from Michigan sprang into action during a medical emergency involving his grandmother. Recognizing her need for help, he took the initiative to leave their house with his younger sister. Fortunately, kind-hearted neighbors noticed the children and promptly summoned emergency services, ensuring his grandmother received critical medical care in a timely manner.
title: Michigan boy, 5, finds grandmother unconscious and runs for help, saving her life

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A collector's chance find at a car boot sale led to a remarkable discovery when he purchased a box of comics for £20, only to unearth rare Superman editions hidden away in his loft for years. Following some online research during the pandemic, he confirmed that these gems, originally commissioned for a family bar mitzvah in 1988, could fetch a stunning £63,440 at auction.
title: UK collector paid £20 for comics; rare Superman issues later sold for £63,440

author: ANJALI SINGH
description: Sonipat athletes shone brightly at the recent Asian Games, bringing home multiple gold medals. The unwavering support from their families, who made significant sacrifices, was instrumental in helping these athletes chase their dreams. Additionally, local sports institutions offered vital training and resources, enabling their talents to blossom. This collective community encouragement is solidifying Sonipat's reputation as a rising sports hub in India.
title: Sonipat’s golden harvest: How Haryana city became India’s medal factory

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In a recent policy shift, the Indian government has raised the export duty on petrol to Rs 2.5 per litre while reducing the diesel duty to Rs 8.5 per litre. This adjustment reflects the government's continuous evaluation of export duties based on global crude oil pricing, which occurs biweekly. Interestingly, the export duty for aviation turbine fuel remains steady at Rs 10.
title: India raises petrol export duty fivefold to Rs 2.5/litre, cuts diesel levy to Rs 8.5

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: In a significant ruling, the Karnataka high court upheld the rights of a pharmaceutical distributor, allowing them a chance to respond before any license suspension. Wellness Forever Chemists had challenged a suspension notice from September 2026. The court emphasized that the distributor should have the opportunity to present its case and permitted the continuation of business operations, though certain product restrictions will apply.
title: Can a drug licence be suspended before a hearing? Karnataka HC explains rule

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: The much-anticipated 'Jailer 2', starring Rajinikanth, has opened to rave reviews and a robust box office performance. Following a four-week run in theaters, the film is set to hit Amazon Prime Video. With notable performers like Ramya Krishnan and Yogi Babu joining Rajinikanth under the direction of Nelson Dilipkumar, it masterfully combines action with a captivating musical score. Fans eagerly await its digital arrival in November 2026.
title: 'Jailer 2' OTT release date: When & where can we expect Rajinikanth starrer online

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Mary Millben alleges that billionaire George Soros is financially backing protests in India with the intention of undermining Prime Minister Modi's government. She urges young Indians to stand with Modi to actively challenge what she deems as disruptive protests. Millben also criticizes Rahul Gandhi of Congress and Abhijeet Dipke of the Cockroach Janta Party for their involvement, while emphasizing that having clear objectives is crucial for impactful change.
title: ‘The name is George Soros’: Mary Millben alleges US funding behind Delhi protests

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: A harrowing tale unfolds as 28-year-old Akash Gupta was reportedly murdered by Rajkumar Gupta and Poonam Devi, driven by tensions surrounding their illicit affair. In a bid to hide their crime, the couple concealed Akash's body in a plastic sack near a canal. Swift investigation efforts, sparked by a tip from the victim's brother, led to their arrest, while police are diligently pursuing other suspects linked to this grave incident.
title: UP couple kills woman’s lover, stuffs body in sack and dumps it in canal

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: On Friday, the Rupee showcased a solid performance, climbing 20 paise to hit 94.79 against the US dollar, building on gains from the previous day aided by a softer dollar and actions by the Reserve Bank of India. Nevertheless, escalating crude oil prices curtailed further advancements, even as domestic equities remained upbeat.
title: Rupee gains 20 paise against US dollar as RBI support kicks in, greenback weakens

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: A woman retired from Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) on June 30, 2020 after more than 30 years of service. She received Rs 9.04 lakh as leave encashment, in addition to her other retirement benefits. While filing her income tax return (ITR), she claimed a tax exemption on the entire leave encashment amount.
title: Taxman capped LIC retiree's leave pay exemption at Rs 3L; ITAT allows Rs 9.04L

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Wasim Jaffer raised eyebrows over Rinku Singh not making the cut for India's T20I lineup, insisting that Rinku's presence might have shifted the tide in the fourth match against the West Indies. He assessed Rinku's batting output at crucial positions, comparing it to his teammates' while underscoring Naman Dhir as a significant player. All eyes are now on the thrilling fifth match set for Saturday.
title: ‘Too ambitious’: Ex-India cricketer flags concerns over Gambhir’s India game plan

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft president Brad Smith expressed concerns about the US government's recent suspension of Green Card sponsorships. He warned that this decision might negatively impact the country’s ability to attract top tech talent. Smith emphasized that the majority of Microsoft's Green Card applications are for long-time employees rather than new hires. He also refuted accusations of visa fraud made by Vice President JD Vance against the company.
title: Microsoft president on Green Card programme suspension: We should all be worried

author: KAUTILYA SINGH AND SUBODH GHILDIYAL
description: Parents of the 2022 Rishikesh resort murder victim protested for justice at India Gate, demanding the removal of Sikkim governor Dushyant Kumar Gautam. Following their detention by Delhi Police, they vowed to intensify their efforts if their demands are not met. Congress leaders, including Rahul Gandhi, supported the family's protest and urged for Gautam's removal during the ongoing investigation.
title: Remove Gautam as Sikkim guv in 24 hrs or face stir: Murder victim’s father

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Student protests are sweeping across France as frustrations rise over overcrowded classrooms and poor school facilities. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu accuses the La France Insoumise party of taking advantage of the situation for political gain. With thousands joined by trade unions and parents, their calls for educational equity harken back to the 1968 student uprising, demanding reforms such as wealth taxes and a voting age reduction to 16.
title: France protests flare as PM accuses radical left of exploiting unrest ahead of elections

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Two pipelines transporting gas and petroleum products in Syria experienced damage due to separate incidents. An explosion occurred on the Jbessa gas pipeline, igniting a fire that required emergency response. Meanwhile, a leak occurred on the Baniyas-Homs pipeline, believed to be linked to attempted fuel theft. The Syrian Petroleum Company is working to repair the damaged sections and maintain gas supplies.
title: Two Syrian pipelines damaged in fresh blow to war-hit energy network

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Gunisha Kaur, a 16-year-old from Ludhiana, creates pollinator gardens to support biodiversity and inclusion. Her initiative, Buzzing Blooms, transforms urban spaces into chemical-free habitats for both pollinators and children. Over 24 months, the project recorded significant increases in pollinator species and bee visitation. Engaging local communities, Buzzing Blooms focuses on inclusive outdoor spaces catering to diverse needs. Through workshops and advocacy, Kaur aims to foster environmental action among youth.
title: Ludhiana teen wins Eco-Hero award for pollinator gardens

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Cricket West Indies CEO Chris Dehring criticised the bilateral revenue model, saying the board earns nothing when the team tours India, despite series potentially generating $20–30 million. He traced the problem to a 1997 ICC decision allowing hosts to retain broadcasting revenue. Dehring blamed the system for West Indies’ financial struggles, which have led to player pay cuts and suspended domestic competitions.
title: ‘Series in India brings nothing to Windies’: Cricket’s revenue model sparks debate

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Reliance Industries has welcomed the entry of Elon Musk's Starlink into the Indian satellite communications market. The company clarified that it has never feared competition and is also awaiting clearances for its satellite services. Musk has alleged that Reliance benefits from monopolistic practices and has questioned regulatory barriers. The Indian government has stated that all companies must comply with existing laws and security requirements.
title: 'Welcome competition including Starlink': Reliance reacts to Musk's comments

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Gelato, a tiny kitten rescued from the streets with injuries, had difficulty using traditional wheelchairs due to his size. Innovative and compassionate individuals repurposed toy cars to create a functioning wheelchair for him. His journey captured the internet’s heart, culminating in his adoption by a caring tattoo artist familiar with the needs of special-needs pets.
title: Shelter builds Hot Wheels wheelchair for tiny kitten, gets adopted

author: etimes.in
description: After winning Fame Gurukul, Qazi Touqeer found himself at a crossroads as he received multiple offers. However, he declined a prominent role from Ekta Kapoor, which sparked misunderstandings. Under pressure while discussing the opportunity, he soon faced backlash from the media, who branded him arrogant for his choice, despite having already committed to a film project.
title: Bigg Boss 20: Qazi recalls saying no to Ekta Kapoor rockstar show; slams media scrutiny

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Chirag Baretha, a decorated para-badminton player, and fellow para-shuttlers have filed a petition after being excluded from India’s 2026 Asian Para Games contingent despite meeting the selection criteria. Alleging unfair treatment and procedural irregularities, they have challenged the roles of the Sports Authority of India (SAI) and the Badminton Association of India (BAI), raising questions about transparency in the selection process.
title: Para-shuttlers challenge Para Asian Games non-selection in Delhi HC

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In West Virginia, plans for a new data center, the Monarch Compute Campus, could mean the removal of around 200 blight-resistant American chestnut trees. Planted in the 1970s, these trees are vital for future restoration projects. Conservationists express concern over the potential loss of this endangered genetic resource, making its fate precarious amidst development considerations and the push for sustainability.
title: 56-year-old chestnut grove, one of America’s last, at risk from AI data center

author: NASEER GANAI
description: Kumar Rajeev Ranjan, an IAS officer, reportedly insulted a subordinate female officer during a video meeting. This incident has sparked widespread condemnation from various political parties in Jammu and Kashmir. Ranjan allegedly used derogatory language and threatened to get the officer suspended. While the labour department claimed the video is fabricated, JKAS officers assert its authenticity. Numerous calls for inquiry and action against Ranjan have been made following this incident.
title: 'I can always talk to you like this': On cam, IAS officer abuses woman during meeting

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: At 36, after years of setbacks, selection hurdles and changing sports, Suchika Tariyal finally has the Asian Games medal she had chased since childhood. India’s first Asian Games MMA medallist came within 700 grams of a place in the final at Aichi-Nagoya. From an eight-time national judo champion to a ju-jitsu world champion, Tariyal’s journey has been shaped by financial strain, doubts over her age and her husband Kapil Hooda’s unwavering faith.
title: ‘Too old’ to Asian Games MMA medallist: Suchika Tariyal’s journey from judo to glory

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel and wife Miranda Kerr are helping erase $550 million in medical debt for more than 261,000 Californians and supporting Los Angeles wildfire survivors. Spiegel recalled watching his childhood home burn during the January 2025 fires. The couple's philanthropy also includes community relief, long-term health research and encouraging their children to give back.
title: Evan Spiegel and Miranda Kerr erase $550M medical debt for Californians

author: etimes.in
description: Vishal Chaturvedi's 'Hanuman Ansh' has earned Rs 338.98 crore in India as of its 70th day in theaters. The film's overseas gross has reached Rs 48.30 crore, contributing to a global total of Rs 448.33 crore. However, Thursday's net earnings declined significantly compared to the previous day. The Hindi and Telugu versions of the movie recorded varying occupancy rates across different shows.
title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office: India collection stands at Rs 338.98 cr

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Maya Angelou's wisdom teaches us to pay attention to actions that unveil true character within relationships. Oprah Winfrey underscores the need to view consistent behavior as significant rather than waving them off as simple mistakes. A relationship thrives on accountability, fostering awareness of recurring patterns. Although trust and forgiveness are vital components, they should never excuse ongoing disrespect or lack of integrity.
title: Maya Angelou: When people show you who they are, believe them the first time

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Former India spinner R Ashwin criticised the team management for dropping Kuldeep Yadav from the last two T20Is against the West Indies, saying the decision “lacks a bit of common sense.” Ashwin argued Kuldeep’s variations troubled the visiting batters and could have saved India 15–20 runs. However, he supported Kuldeep’s exclusion in Indore due to the ground’s small dimensions.
title: ‘Lacks common sense’: Ashwin blasts India over Kuldeep’s exclusion

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: The investigation into Shiva Sharma's death has led authorities to search for Shraddha Dubey across borders. CCTV footage reportedly shows Shraddha, her sister Rashmi, and an associate Adil in Nepal. They are believed to have fled Lucknow soon after the incident, raising suspicion. Sharma's family has alleged foul play, while Dubey maintains her innocence and claims he died by suicide.
title: Absconding in UP bizman murder case, accused model Shraddha Dubey may be in Nepal

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Amid fluctuating oil markets, current tensions in the Middle East and possible shifts in US sanctions have resulted in a marginal decline in oil prices. WTI crude is priced at $97.31, with Brent crude at $105.40. While recent moves to lift restrictions on certain vessels aim to counter soaring global freight rates, the International Energy Agency's diesel release hasn't completely eased concerns about oil supply.
title: Oil prices dip marginally as US weighs easing sanctions on ‘shadow fleet’ tankers

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Teenage cricket star Vaibhav Sooryavanshi went viral after jokingly warning airport paparazzi, “Reel ke chakkar mein thuk jaoge,” urging them to prioritise safety over filming. He was in New Delhi to meet PM Narendra Modi during a felicitation ceremony for India’s Asian Games contingent. Modi encouraged athletes to inspire children, highlighting sports’ role in teaching discipline, resilience and perseverance through his message, “Jo Khelega, Woh Khilega.”
title: 'Reel ke chakkar mein thuk jaoge': Sooryavanshi warns paps - Watch

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Ukraine's shortage of Patriot air defence missiles has left it exposed to Russian missile attacks and critical infrastructure damage. Recent attacks have targeted power plants in Kyiv and Kharkiv, resulting in casualties. Relations between Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and the US government have soured amid disputes over energy and military support. Additionally, limitations on Starlink connectivity have disrupted military operations in Ukraine.
title: Zelenskyy’s worst nightmare is here: Ukraine runs out of Patriot missiles

author: AHMED ALI
description: Imran Khan has been asked by the FRRO to leave India by October 28, raising legal concerns. Lawyers argue that he did not participate in the protest and only passed through the area. The police have charged the protestors for illegal assembly due to lacking permission for the demonstration. Legal representatives plan to seek CCTV footage to support Khan's claims regarding his involvement.
title: Imran Khan was just passing through, didn’t take part in Mumbai protests: Lawyers

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Hillingdon Council in west London is urging residents to identify suspected fly-tippers through CCTV images shared on Facebook. The enforcement drive has resulted in more than 300 fixed penalty notices worth around £134,000. England recorded over 1.26 million fly-tipping incidents last year, a 9% increase, with serious offenders facing prison sentences.
title: Hillingdon Council urges help to ID fly-tippers as fines top £134K

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In 2011, Taylor Swift generously donated 6,000 books to bolster local libraries in Berks County amid looming budget cuts. This pivotal support allowed the Reading Public Library to enrich its programs and attract thousands of community members. By 2025, the library circulated over 182,000 items and continued to foster engagement through various initiatives, proving Swift’s contribution remains vital for the region's library services to this day.
title: Taylor Swift's 2011 book donation helped save Pennsylvania library

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Melissa and Mike Morris dedicated nearly a year to constructing a stunning 100,000-gallon swimming lagoon in Olathe, Kansas. Inspired by the beauty of Tahiti, they created a coastal paradise at home, complete with granite rocks, flowing waterfalls, and vibrant tropical fish. Their captivating project drew attention online, leading to requests for exclusive photo sessions and events, while they relish their private backyard oasis as they finalize the landscaping.
title: Kansas couple builds 100,000-gallon lagoon in backyard

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Scientists have reprogrammed blood-cell precursors from an 80-year-old donor into neural stem cells with an epigenetic age below 20, according to a study published in Aging Cell. The process unfolded gradually over more than 100 days, offering researchers a way to investigate cellular rejuvenation and its potential implications for ageing and Alzheimer's research.
title: Scientists rejuvenate 80-year-old's cells to under 20 in 100 days

title: PM Modi to visit Canada on December 11-12 as India, Ottawa push to boost ties

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Brittany Mahomes is helping the Kansas City Current attract 18,000 fans for its October 25 match against the Washington Spirit, aiming to grow women's soccer in Kansas City. Meanwhile, Patrick Mahomes is using the Chiefs' early bye week to rest his injured knee before facing the Chargers on October 18. The quarterback has recorded 1,037 passing yards and nine touchdowns in four games this season, helping Kansas City remain unbeaten.
title: Brittany Mahomes takes major step to boost women's soccer in Kansas City

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' was released on October 15 and generated impressive opening day earnings. The film collected Rs 59.70 cr net in India and Rs 70.25 cr gross from local shows. Its overall worldwide gross reached Rs 125.25 cr, including Rs 55 cr from international markets. The Tamil version of 'Jailer 2' contributed significantly to the box office performance with high occupancy rates.
title: 'Jailer 2' box office collection: Rajinikanth's film earns Rs 59.70cr net in India

author: SRIKANTH ALURI
description: Telugu families in the US no longer need to travel to India for a traditional wedding. Texas, especially Austin, Frisco and Dallas, is emerging as a top destination, thanks to a booming ecosystem of purohits, caterers, planners, photographers and sprawling NRI-owned venues. From turmeric roots to betel leaves, every ritual essential is available locally, helping the diaspora preserve age-old customs, avoid visa hassles and celebrate with friends and relatives nearby.
title: A slice of Andhra in US: Texas emerges as a hub for grand Telugu weddings

author: KOUSHIKI SAHA
description: Many voters in Delhi, including a former MP and a teacher, expressed grievances about deletion from electoral rolls. Multiple individuals reported missing names despite submitting relevant documents and fulfilling enrollment processes. The recent hearings highlighted significant discrepancies in voter eligibility criteria, particularly affecting marginalized communities. Independent commissions recommend public verification of electoral rolls to rectify inaccuracies before finalization.
title: ‘Pehle vote gaya, phir jhuggi gayi’: Delhi hearing flags SIR deletions, discrepancies

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The Kansas City Chiefs stars, Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce, showcased their commitment to charity by donating signed jerseys that sold for a remarkable $250,000. This generous contribution is part of the Big Slick Celebrity Weekend, which successfully raised $3.97 million for pediatric cancer initiatives at Children's Mercy Hospital, bringing total donations to over $21 million since the event's launch in 2010.
title: Kelce and Mahomes jerseys sell for $250K in charity auction
